steers.title: Trade cluster: SOL + IOTA
steers.detail: Both opened within 2 minutes. Correlation risk.

deep_analysis:
BTC is pinned AT the continuum EMA300 (~120m+), volatility LOW, velocity SLOW, auto_trader scoring CHOP/BRACKET — this is a chop tape, and chop is where our losses come from: 7d no-trail cohort 71T 25.4% WR -$2.10 vs trail cohort 36T 94.4% WR +$2.50. Both open trades (SOL #16969 long +0.4%, IOTA #16970 long flat, both 25min old) were opened mid-band (meta_rsi 52.2 / 57.1) during the pin — exactly the never-armed-entry cohort that carries 81.4% of 7d gross loss.

Would I open them fresh right now? SOL: borderline — jup_yolo_mirrored is the healthiest live family (7d 18T 66.7% WR +$0.13) and SOL is NEUTRAL not bearish, but the EMA300 chop-pin says mid-band longs have no edge. IOTA: no — r2v2-long3 is 7d 3T 33% WR -$0.12 (all-window 7T 42.9% -$0.30), weakest live long family, and IOTA regime is NEUTRAL conf 43.5 with zero trend. SLs (-0.73% / -0.75% from entry) are sane for current ATR; neither is up 2% so no BE stop is due yet.

Wrong-side check on the 24h losers (6 trades, ALL LONG, ALL mid-band meta_rsi 33-59): the clearest wrong-side call is GRASS #16967 LONG pump-chain+ while GRASS 15m regime was SHORT_BIAS conf 86.8 and falling -2.51%/16 candles. The winning side was SHORT that coin — we bought a falling knife because a pump signal fired against a strong bearish regime. GMT/SOL/WLD longs were mid-band entries into the same pin: not wrong-direction so much as no-trend — they never reached +0.40% to arm trail, then ATR-SL took them.

Steers (condition-keyed, re-test next cycle):
- 🟡 Exit SOL #16969 and IOTA #16970 if neither reaches +0.40% MFE by ~05:15 UTC (2h after open) while BTC 1m still closes AT/around continuum EMA300 — never-armed chop-pin entries are the 81.4% bleed cohort (7d dollar share). If BTC resolves and holds clearly above EMA300 with the longs armed (+0.40% MFE), hold and let trail work.
- 🟡 IOTA is the weaker of the two (dead family, neutral regime): close IOTA first if the pair must be de-risked to one.
- 🟢 No 2%/5% BE-or-trail steers due — max open gain is +0.47%. No trade open 8h+.

AI Trader: NOT fired this cycle. AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False (watchlist-only anyway) and every precheck candidate failed on substance: ASTER no price data, PENGU short-blacklisted, APT SHORT R:R 0.38 hard-blocked, GRASS SHORT passes gates but sits in the 45-55 death zone (7d 15-22% WR) under the same EMA300 chop-pin advisory — writing it would be recommending the exact chop entry this watchdog exists to stop. Prior pick NEAR LONG 00:14Z still within watchlist reference window.
regime_context: Sources disagree — always cited: aggregate 15m scanner (regime_5m.json 03:30Z) = SHORT_BIAS (17 short / 7 long / 103 neutral of 127); watchdog btc_15m = SHORT_BIAS; btc_4h = LONG_BIAS; continuum 1m = AT EMA300, linreg LEAN_BULL, trend_quality STRONG_UP; auto_trader regime = CHOP (BRACKET decision, last 6 cycles all CHOP). Flip-rate check: aggregate 19 flips/24h, BTC 23 flips/24h — both inside the normal band (p50 20, p95 26; ≥26 = unusually unstable, neither is), so direction state survives ~1h and snapshot directional prose must stay condition-keyed. Practical read: 1m structure leans bull, 15m aggregate leans short, and price is pinned on the EMA300 line — no trustworthy trend to be long or short with size. Positioning: 2/2 open trades are LONG against the aggregate short bias but aligned with the 1m lean-bull; 48h realized longs are the winning side (LONG 20T 55% WR +$0.19 vs SHORT 8T 50% WR -$0.09), so the longs are not categorically wrong — they are early/untrended. Regime resolution trigger to watch: BTC 1m holding above vs below continuum EMA300; that decides whether these longs have a trend to ride.
